nodes.name: Set Global Config
nodes.notes:
CONFIGURATION HUB: All settings live here.

MODELS:
- config.research_model: deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro (best 1M context + reasoning)
- config.content_model: mistralai/mistral-medium-3.5-128b (best instruction following)
- config.qc_model: mistralai/mistral-medium-3.5-128b (best structured validation)

OTHER MODELS AVAILABLE ON NVIDIA NIM:
- nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b (fastest, best for agentic orchestration)
- deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash (cheapest: $0.14/$0.28 per 1M tokens)
- minimaxai/minimax-m3 (best for video/image-aware content)

CREDENTIAL SETUP:
Create a Header Auth credential in n8n named 'NVIDIA NIM API':
  Header Name:  Authorization
  Header Value: Bearer YOUR_NVIDIA_API_KEY
Get your key at: https://build.nvidia.com

nodes.name: Merge Topic + Config
nodes.notes: MERGE: Consolidates topic + all config into a single data object. All downstream nodes reference this. This is the single source of truth for the workflow execution.

nodes.name: Research Agent (HTTP - DeepSeek V4 Pro)
nodes.notes:
RESEARCH STAGE: Calls NVIDIA NIM API using DeepSeek V4 Pro (1M token context, deep reasoning). Temperature 0.7 for balanced research.

CREDENTIAL: Select your 'NVIDIA NIM API' Header Auth credential here.

TO SWITCH MODELS: Change config.research_model in 'Set Global Config' node.

RESPONSE PATH: $json.choices[0].message.content

assignments.name: research
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const c = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; return typeof c === 'string' ? JSON.parse(c) : (c || {}); } catch(e) { return {}; } })() }}

nodes.name: Parse Research Output
nodes.notes: PARSE: Extracts research JSON from NVIDIA NIM response at choices[0].message.content. Carries all config values forward. Safe try/catch prevents failures on malformed responses.

nodes.name: Content Generator (HTTP - Mistral Medium 3.5)
nodes.notes:
CONTENT GENERATION: Calls Mistral Medium 3.5 via NVIDIA NIM. Temperature 0.85 for creativity. reasoning_effort: none for fast natural creative writing (Mistral-specific parameter that prevents robotic chain-of-thought in output).

TO SWITCH MODELS: Change config.content_model in 'Set Global Config'.
If using a non-Mistral model, remove the 'reasoning_effort' body parameter.

RESPONSE PATH: $json.choices[0].message.content

assignments.name: instagram_post
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const c = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; const p = typeof c === 'string' ? JSON.parse(c) : c; return p?.instagram_post || ''; } catch(e) { return ''; } })() }}

assignments.name: facebook_post
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const c = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; const p = typeof c === 'string' ? JSON.parse(c) : c; return p?.facebook_post || ''; } catch(e) { return ''; } })() }}

assignments.name: linkedin_post
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const c = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; const p = typeof c === 'string' ? JSON.parse(c) : c; return p?.linkedin_post || ''; } catch(e) { return ''; } })() }}

assignments.name: tiktok_post
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const c = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; const p = typeof c === 'string' ? JSON.parse(c) : c; return p?.tiktok_post || ''; } catch(e) { return ''; } })() }}

assignments.name: image_prompt
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const c = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; const p = typeof c === 'string' ? JSON.parse(c) : c; return p?.image_prompt || ''; } catch(e) { return ''; } })() }}

nodes.name: Parse Content Output
nodes.notes: PARSE: Safely extracts all 4 platform posts and image prompt from NVIDIA NIM response at choices[0].message.content. Uses try/catch for safe JSON parsing.

nodes.name: Quality Check (HTTP - Mistral Medium 3.5)
nodes.notes:
QUALITY GATE: Temperature 0.1 for deterministic validation. reasoning_effort: high forces Mistral to deeply evaluate all rules before deciding (opposite of content generation). Returns APPROVE or REGENERATE.

RESPONSE PATH: $json.choices[0].message.content

assignments.name: validation_result
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const c = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; return typeof c === 'string' ? JSON.parse(c) : (c || {validation_passed: true, recommendation: 'APPROVE'}); } catch(e) { return {validation_passed: true, recommendation: 'APPROVE'}; } })() }}

assignments.name: quality_approved
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const c = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; const r = typeof c === 'string' ? JSON.parse(c) : c; return r?.recommendation === 'APPROVE'; } catch(e) { return true; } })() }}

nodes.name: Parse QC Result
nodes.notes: PARSE QC: Extracts quality check result from choices[0].message.content. Sets quality_approved boolean. Falls back to true on parse error to prevent infinite loops.

nodes.name: Quality Gate
nodes.notes:
QUALITY GATE ROUTER:
- Output 0 (true): APPROVED → proceeds to Image Generation
- Output 1 (false): FAILED → routes to Retry Check

nodes.name: Retry Check (Max Retries?)
nodes.notes: RETRY GUARD: Checks if retry_count < max_retries (default 3). If yes → increments and loops back to Content Generator. If no → routes to Error Handler.

nodes.name: Increment Retry Counter
nodes.notes:
RETRY PREP: Increments retry_count and prepares data for another content generation attempt.

MANUAL CONNECTION REQUIRED: Connect this node's output to 'Content Generator (HTTP - Mistral Medium 3.5)' input to create the retry loop.

assignments.name: error_message
assignments.value: ={{ 'Content quality validation failed after ' + $json.retry_count + ' retries. Maximum retries reached.' }}

nodes.name: Error: Max Retries Exceeded
nodes.notes: ERROR HANDLER: Triggered when max retries reached without passing QC. Connect to Slack / Email node for alerts.

nodes.name: Parse Image URL
nodes.notes: PARSE IMAGE: Extracts image URL from DALL-E response. Handles both URL and base64 formats.

assignments.name: duration_seconds

nodes.name: Build Final Output (JSON)
nodes.notes: FINAL OUTPUT: Assembles the complete structured JSON output per spec. Contains all 4 posts, image URL, topic, timestamps, model used, and execution duration.

parameters.content:
## AI Social Media Content Generator
### NVIDIA NIM Edition

All LLM nodes now use HTTP Request
nodes calling the NVIDIA NIM API.

API Base: https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1
All endpoints are OpenAI-compatible.

**Model Stack:**
Research → DeepSeek V4 Pro
Content  → Mistral Medium 3.5
Quality  → Mistral Medium 3.5
Image    → DALL-E 3 (OpenAI)

**Credential needed:**
Header Auth named 'NVIDIA NIM API'
  Name:  Authorization
  Value: Bearer YOUR_KEY

## NVIDIA NIM CREDENTIAL SETUP

1. Go to Settings > Credentials
2. Click Add Credential
3. Choose: Header Auth
4. Name it exactly: NVIDIA NIM API
5. Header Name:  Authorization
6. Header Value: Bearer YOUR_NVIDIA_KEY
7. Save

Get your API key free at:
https://build.nvidia.com

Free tier: ~40 req/min
No per-token charge for prototyping

After creating, open each HTTP Request
node and select 'NVIDIA NIM API' from
the credential dropdown.

## MODEL CONFIGURATION
Edit 'Set Global Config' to change:

config.research_model
  deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro (default)
  nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b

config.content_model
  mistralai/mistral-medium-3.5-128b (default)
  deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro

config.qc_model
  mistralai/mistral-medium-3.5-128b (default)
  deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash (cheaper)

BUDGET OPTION: Set all three to
  deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash
  Cost: ~$0.001 per full run

## RETRY LOOP
Manual connection required:

'Increment Retry Counter' output
  ---> 'Content Generator
        (HTTP - Mistral Medium 3.5)' input

This creates the auto-regeneration
cycle when quality check fails.
Max retries set in Set Global Config
(default: 3).

## PUBLISHING
Each platform output is ready:

Instagram Output --> Instagram API
Facebook Output  --> Facebook Graph
LinkedIn Output  --> LinkedIn API
TikTok Output    --> TikTok API

Or connect all to Buffer / Hootsuite
/ Agorapulse / Later webhook.

## EXTERNAL TOPIC SOURCES
To use Sheets/Airtable/Notion/Webhook:

1. Add the respective n8n node
2. Connect it BEFORE 'External Topic
   Input' node
3. Set config.topic_source to
   anything other than 'manual'
4. Ensure your data has a 'topic'
   or 'Topic' field

## reasoning_effort PARAMETER

This is a Mistral-specific parameter:

Content Generator: reasoning_effort = none
  Prevents robotic chain-of-thought.
  Makes output more natural and fluid.

Quality Check: reasoning_effort = high
  Forces deep rule evaluation before
  deciding to APPROVE or REGENERATE.

If you switch to DeepSeek or Nemotron,
remove the reasoning_effort body
parameter from those nodes (it will
be ignored but cleaner to remove).

parameters.value: query GetChannels($OrganizationId: OrganizationId!) {   channels(input: { organizationId: $OrganizationId }) {     id     name     service   } }

nodes.name: Buffer: Get Connected Profiles
nodes.notes:
BUFFER STAGE 2: Fetches all connected social channels for the organization.
"Channels" is the new GraphQL name for what the REST API called "Profiles".

Requires organizationId from previous node (Buffer: Get Account & Org ID).
Uses GraphQL variables to safely pass the org ID (no string concatenation).

RESPONSE PATH: $json.data.channels (array with id, name, service fields)

nodes.name: Buffer: Parse & Map Profiles
nodes.notes:
BUFFER STAGE 3: Maps GraphQL channels response (data.channels) to platform-keyed channel IDs.
Also carries all captions and image URL forward from Build Final Output.
Logs all channel IDs and caption lengths for full observability.

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: mutation CreatePost($input: CreatePostInput!) { createPost(input: $input) { ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id text status dueAt } } ... on MutationError { message } } }

parameters.name: variables
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const input = {   text: $json.instagram_post,   channelId: $json.instagram_profile_id,   schedulingType: 'automatic',   mode: 'shareNow',   instagram: { type: 'post' } }; if ($json.image_url) {   input.assets = [{ image: { url: $json.image_url } }]; } return { input }; })() }}

nodes.name: Buffer: Publish Instagram
nodes.notes:
BUFFER PUBLISH: Instagram
Caption field: instagram_post (never mixed with other platforms)
Image: attached as media[0] when image_url is present (no re-upload)
Publish mode: shareNow (immediate)

GraphQL errors return as MutationError in response body (HTTP stays 200).
Check data.createPost.__typename: PostActionSuccess vs MutationError.

To schedule: change mode to 'customScheduled', add dueAt: 'ISO8601_UTC_STRING'
To queue: change mode to 'addToQueue'

Fault tolerant: continueOnFail=true. One platform failure never stops others.
Retry: 3 attempts with 4s backoff.
